Meet Candy Corn

Sweet as her name, Candy Corn is a precious girl who deserves a fresh start! Rescued from a difficult situation in the Bronx, she is finally getting the chance to leave the past behind and discover what it feels like to be safe, loved, and cherished.

Candy Corn has a sweet nature and so much love to give. Now she’s hoping to find a family who will shower her with affection, guide her as she grows, and make her feel like the special little girl she is.

She’s ready for a lifetime of happy days, cozy cuddles, and unconditional love. Could you be the one to give Candy Corn her happily ever after?

Please remember that adoption bios are only a snapshot of each animal. Reach out to our Adoption Team for additional information about Candy Corn and to learn if she may be the right fit for your home.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
